# Unicode fixtures (WORK-002). Expected layout follows D-042: grapheme clustering
# (mode 2027) on, libghostty widths, ambiguous characters narrow.
#
# Format: id  widths  input  [stored [conpty]]
#   widths  cell span of each grapheme cluster, left to right, comma separated (1 or 2)
#   input   bytes written to the terminal; <hex> is a codepoint, <xHH> one raw byte,
#           anything else is literal. Write <20> for a space.
#   stored  the codepoints the grid keeps, when they differ from input (invalid UTF-8)
#   conpty  explicit decoded output when Windows replaces malformed bytes differently
#
# The file is ASCII only, so an editor cannot normalize a decomposed case without it
# showing in the diff. Expectations come from the policy, not from current output;
# change one only with a reason in the commit message.

# Latin and combining marks
latin.precomposed          1          <E9>
latin.decomposed           1          e<301>
latin.word                 1,1,1,1    caf<E9>
latin.word-decomposed      1,1,1,1    cafe<301>
combining.stack            1          a<301><302><323><324>
combining.above-below      1          o<308><331>
vietnamese.precomposed     1          <1EC7>
vietnamese.decomposed      1          e<323><302>
combining.after-wide       2          <754C><301>

# Other scripts. Right-to-left text is stored in logical order; bidi is out of scope.
greek                      1,1,1,1    <39A><3B1><3BB><3CC>
cyrillic                   1,1,1      <41F><440><438>
hebrew                     1,1,1,1    <5E9><5DC><5D5><5DD>
hebrew.points              1          <5E9><5C1><5B8>
arabic                     1,1,1,1,1  <645><631><62D><628><627>
devanagari.syllable        2          <915><93F>      # spacing vowel sign widens the cluster
devanagari.conjunct        2          <915><94D><937>
thai.tone                  1          <E01><E48>
hangul.syllable            2          <D55C>
hangul.jamo                2          <1100><1161><11A8>

# East Asian wide
cjk.ideograph              2          <754C>
cjk.pair                   2,2        <65E5><672C>
cjk.mixed                  1,2,1      a<754C>b
fullwidth.latin            2          <FF21>
kana                       2,2        <3072><3089>
halfwidth.kana             1          <FF8A>

# Emoji
emoji.default              2          <1F600>
emoji.text-default         1          <2764>
emoji.vs16                 2          <2764><FE0F>
emoji.vs15                 1          <231A><FE0E>
emoji.smiley-vs16          2          <263A><FE0F>
emoji.keycap               2          1<FE0F><20E3>
emoji.flag                 2          <1F1EF><1F1F5>
emoji.flag-pair            2,2        <1F1EF><1F1F5><1F1FA><1F1F8>
emoji.regional-lone        2          <1F1EF>
emoji.skin-tone            2          <1F44D><1F3FD>
emoji.zwj-profession       2          <1F469><200D><1F4BB>
emoji.zwj-family           2          <1F468><200D><1F469><200D><1F467><200D><1F466>
emoji.zwj-rainbow-flag     2          <1F3F3><FE0F><200D><1F308>
emoji.tag-sequence         2          <1F3F4><E0067><E0062><E0073><E0063><E0074><E007F>
emoji.after-text           1,2,1      a<1F600>b

# Joiners attach to the preceding cluster; libghostty drops other zero-width format characters
zero-width.joiner          1,1        a<200D>b
zero-width.non-joiner      1,1        a<200C>b
zero-width.space           1,1        a<200B>b          ab      # libghostty drops it
variation.invalid-base     1,1        a<FE0F>b          ab      # ignored and dropped
format.soft-hyphen         1,1,1      a<AD>b
format.bom                 1          <FEFF>a           a

# Invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD without shifting what follows
invalid.byte               1,1        <xFF>a            <FFFD>a
invalid.truncated          1,1        <xE2><x82>a       <FFFD>a
invalid.overlong           1,1,1      <xC0><xAF>a       <FFFD><FFFD>a
invalid.surrogate          1,1,1,1    <xED><xA0><x80>a  <FFFD><FFFD><FFFD>a  <FFFD><FFFD>a

# Symbols used by prompts and TUIs, and East Asian Ambiguous characters (narrow)
box-drawing                1,1,1      <250C><2500><2510>
block-elements             1,1        <2588><2591>
braille                    1          <28FF>
powerline                  1          <E0B0>
nerd-font                  1          <F418>
ambiguous                  1,1,1      <B1><A7><2192>
dash.three-em              2          <2E3B>
